subject: Pilot roll-forward: roles, infra commitments & kickoff next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Lee <simon.lee@greenriverhealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@greenriverhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot roll-forward: roles, infra commitments & kickoff next steps

Simon / Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the concrete next steps so we keep the pilot scoped and predictable. I noted action items by owner and a proposed 3-week timeline below. Please flag anything missing.

Scope (agreed):
- 2-week pilot using Redwood Hosted endpoint (standard data retention) against a narrow clinical notes classification task (2500 sample docs)
- Success criteria: 85% macro-F1 on labeled set OR measured reduction in triage time by 30% for the test cohort

Key technical checkpoints and ownership (proposed):
- App integration (API contract, sample payloads): GreenRiver App team (Priya)
- Infrastructure/network (egress, port whitelist, proxy): GreenRiver CloudOps (cloudops@greenriverhealth.com) — we need inbound/outbound port list + proxy/Bastion details
- Data & privacy (PHI handling, retention): GreenRiver legal & our compliance contact — early ask: confirm whether we need Private deployment or Hosted with a BAA
- Model & runtime (model variant, token quota, KV cache behavior): Marissa (Solutions Engineer) — I will loop Marissa for performance profile and small sample runs
- Project management & acceptance: Simon (project sponsor) and Monica (CS lead) from Redwood for day-to-day cadence

Proposed timeline (start week 0 = next Tuesday):
- Day 0–2: exchange sample payloads and success criteria spreadsheet (attached: GRH-POC-success-criteria.xlsx)
- Day 3–7: network checklist & allowlist verification (attach: network-ports-checklist.pdf) — CloudOps to confirm
- Week 2: baseline run + first evaluation report
- Week 3: acceptance review and go/no-go decision

Immediate asks for GreenRiver:
1) Priya — share sample payload (anonymized) and the API contract you plan to use by EOD Friday
2) CloudOps — confirm whether outbound 443 is allowed to redwood-hosted.example.com and provide proxy details by next Monday
3) Simon — confirm sponsor and final success metric (F1 threshold vs. process time) so we can lock evaluation plan

Attachments included: GRH-POC-success-criteria.xlsx (proposal), network-ports-checklist.pdf

I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff once we have payload + network confirmation.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415-555-0198

---
Attachment stubs: GRH-POC-success-criteria.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB), network-ports-checklist.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

From: Simon Lee <simon.lee@greenriverhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@greenriverhealth.com>, cloudops@greenriverhealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot roll-forward: roles, infra commitments & kickoff next steps

Thanks Karthik — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- We prefer Redwood Hosted for speed of execution but will need a BAA signed before PHI is used. Legal is looped separately (not on this thread).
- Success metric: let's aim for the 30% triage time reduction as primary; F1 as secondary. We want both reported.
- Priya will send anonymized payloads today.
- CloudOps: we are okay with outbound 443 to the specified hostname but need confirmation on client IPs and any TLS inspection proxy which may break long-lived streams.

Also, can Redwood supply a short RACI grid for the items you listed? That will help us route approvals internally quickly.

Simon
Simon Lee
Head of AI Platforms | GreenRiver Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@greenriverhealth.com>, cloudops@greenriverhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Simon Lee <simon.lee@greenriverhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot roll-forward: roles, infra commitments & kickoff next steps

Priya / CloudOps — appreciate the quick turnaround. I've attached a lightweight RACI grid below and a tightening of owners/timelines so approvals are explicit. Please counter if you prefer different owners.

RACI (high level) — Pilot: clinical notes classification
- Responsible: GreenRiver App (Priya) — provide payloads + test harness
- Accountable: Simon Lee (GreenRiver) — sponsor + acceptance sign-off
- Consulted: Marissa Cole (Redwood SE) — model config & run tuning
- Informed: Monica Patel (Redwood CS) — cadence & roll-forward recommendations

Network & security checklist (CloudOps items):
- Confirm outbound to redwood-hosted.example.com over 443 (expected client IPs: 34.82.1.14, 34.82.1.15) — CloudOps
- Confirm whether TLS inspection/proxy will truncate streaming responses; if yes, we will need a short-lived tunnel or Private deployment — CloudOps

Milestones & owner cutoffs:
- By EOD Thu (20 Aug): Priya to provide anonymized sample payloads and test harness link
- By Mon (24 Aug): CloudOps to confirm ports/IPs and proxy behavior
- By Tue (25 Aug): Redwood to perform a smoke run and share baseline metrics
- By Fri (28 Aug): Joint acceptance review (30-minute call)

Notes on data: do not send any PHI in raw form until BAA is executed. If you need to run with PHI earlier, we can propose a Private deployment quote but that adds lead time — Marissa will provide options during the smoke run.

I'll pencil in a kickoff slot for Tue (25 Aug) 10:00–10:30 PT and send a calendar invite once CloudOps confirms network.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot roll-forward: roles, infra commitments & kickoff next steps

Quick internal note (looping external for awareness):

- I'll own the smoke runs and performance profiling. For the initial run we'll use the small L2 quantized variant to minimize token cost and get latency baselines. If we hit accuracy gaps, I will propose a candidate model swap and quantify cost/latency deltas in the same report.
- Monica, I'll coordinate the acceptance checklist items (exportable eval report, labelled sample set, and the triage time measurement protocol).
- Priya / CloudOps: I'll need the anonymized payloads plus one example of the proxy TLS header if you have it; that will let me validate streaming behavior.

See you on the kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
